title: Salade niçoise with tuna and egg
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the beans for the last 5 minutes; boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Cool everything in cold water, slice the potatoes and peel and quarter the eggs.
Whisk the oil, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes and olives on plates, top with the tuna and eggs and drizzle with the dressing.
